subject: Social Media
title: Can We Fix This?
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Can We Fix This?.

hook.text: Shame is older than language. Social media is newer than a generation. Ancient instincts on alien tools.

buildup.text: Three forces could help: better design, smarter regulation, and cultural norms that value empathy over rage.

discovery.text: Some communities model it already. Wikipedia resolves conflicts through structured debate. Imperfect but real.

twist.text: Fixing online shaming may mean accepting a slower, less engaging internet. That's a trade-off few want.

climax.text: The tools exist. The research is clear. What's missing is will—corporate, political, and personal.

punchline.text: We built the mob's tools. We can redesign them.

quiz.question: What is the core challenge in fixing online mob behavior?
options: The will to change is missing
